fullDescription: A playful, modern login interface featuring a minimalist geometric illustration style with 'kawaii' character aesthetics. The design balances professional clean layouts with vibrant, animated shapes. Utilizing a split-screen approach, it pairs a charcoal-and-purple primary palette with pops of orange and yellow. Ideal for ed-tech, creative SaaS platforms, Gen-Z focused fintech, or lifestyle applications that want to convey personality and friendliness without sacrificing professional usability. Includes floating CSS animations, rounded UI components, and high-quality typography pairing.

structured.summary: A clean, two-column login page layout with a vibrant left-side branding area containing floating geometric characters and a high-precision, minimalist right-side form. The design uses 'General Sans' and 'Satoshi' for a modern, tech-forward feel.

style.description: The style is characterized by playful minimalism. It uses bold primary colors (#6C5CE7 purple, #2D3436 charcoal) alongside warm accents (#FF8C42 orange, #FFD93D yellow). Typography uses 'General Sans' for headings and 'Satoshi' for body text. Elements feature soft corners (12px to 48px radius) and subtle elevation using 2xl shadows. Key animations include 'float' (6s, 5s, 4s cycles) and 'twinkle' (3s cycle) for background elements.
style.prompt: Apply a design style that uses #F7F7F7 for secondary backgrounds and #FFFFFF for primary containers. Primary accent is #6C5CE7 (Purple) and primary text/buttons are #2D3436 (Charcoal). Use 'General Sans' for H1 titles (4xl, 36px, weight 700) and 'Satoshi' for all body, labels, and input text (weights 400-600). Inputs should have a border-radius of 12px (rounded-xl) with a 1px border (#E5E7EB) and a 2px focus ring of #6C5CE7. Primary buttons must be #2D3436 with white text, featuring a hover transform of -2px Y-axis. Secondary buttons should be white with a #E5E7EB border. Animations should include a floating effect: @keyframes float { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0px) rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: translateY(-20px) rotate(3deg); } }.

layout_and_structure.description: A 50/50 split-screen layout on desktop, collapsing to a single-column form on mobile. The left side is an immersive illustration zone; the right side is a centered, high-focus form area.

prompts.prompt: Create a wrapper with min-height: 100vh and a flex-row layout. On screen widths below 1024px, switch to a vertical column layout.

Occupies 50% width on desktop. Background color #F7F7F7. Includes an absolute-positioned logo at top-left (12px gap, 32px icon). Centered in this area is a composition of four floating geometric characters (pill, circle, and semi-circle shapes). Character 1: #6C5CE7 (36x48 units), Character 2: #2D3436 (32x44 units), Character 3: #FF8C42 (44x22 semi-circle), Character 4: #FFD93D (32x40 units). Each character features 'kawaii' face details: 14px white circle eyes and a 12px-16px wide arc for a smile.

White background, flex-1, with 48px horizontal padding on desktop. Centered content area max-width of 448px (max-w-md). Title section: H1 (Welcome back!) followed by a gray-500 subtitle. Form group spacing: 24px (space-y-6) between inputs. Footer link section: 32px top margin (mt-8).

special_ui_components.description: Highly stylized shapes with simple faces that animate independently.
special_ui_components.prompt: Construct characters using div elements with varied border-radius (e.g., 48px for pill shapes, 50% for circles, top-half rounded for semi-circles). Faces are composed of small absolute-positioned divs: eyes (white/charcoal circles with tiny 'reflection' dots inside) and smiles (border-bottom with rounded-full). Apply different 'animate-float' classes with staggered durations (4s to 6s) and cubic-bezier timing for organic movement.

special_ui_components.description: Sleek input fields with specific attention to focus states and internal icons.
special_ui_components.prompt: Inputs should be 48px height (py-3) with 16px horizontal padding. Font: Satoshi, size: 14px. Border color: #E5E7EB. Focus state: border-transparent with box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #6C5CE7. Password fields must include an absolute-positioned eye icon toggle (#9CA3AF) at the right edge.
